summary: Frontend-only testing completed for Kangqore enterprise website route fixes. All tested routes for generated content pages (blogs, case studies, white papers, events) are now accessible and working correctly. The Communities page redesign with 'The Kangqore Knowledge Network' content is rendering properly.

communities_page.details: The Kangqore Knowledge Network page renders correctly with hero section, knowledge pillars, and platform sections

blog_detail_pages.details: Blog detail pages load correctly with title, author, date, content, and tags

case_study_detail_pages.details: Case study detail pages load correctly with challenge, solution, results, and project details

white_paper_detail_pages.details: White paper detail pages load correctly with download button, topics, and author information

event_detail_pages.details: Event detail pages load correctly with date, location, agenda, and speakers

listing_to_detail_navigation.details: Navigation from all listing pages to detail pages works correctly

context_for_next_testing_agent: All content detail page routes have been verified working. Routes tested: 2 blogs, 2 case studies, 2 white papers, 2 events, and the communities page. Navigation from listing pages to detail pages confirmed working for all content types.
